Strategy: Strengthen the winning wide band reward to thirty, testing whether a bigger bonus for leftovers between twenty-five and fifty improves further. It may help by committing harder to the good window, but may fail if the stronger bonus overrides tight fits too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (30 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 50 else 0) for r in bins]
```
